meta.revisionPolicy: Section 42 figures are provisional, then final; sectoral credit is provisional and revised the next month; NPAs and capital ratios are final on release. Seams disclosed, never joined: the 2019 sectoral classification, the July 2023 HDFC merger, the December 2025 reporting calendar.
meta.base: Statistical Tables Relating to Banks in India
meta.coverage: Priority sector advances of every scheduled commercial bank by sector: accounts and amounts outstanding, each year (discontinued)
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 983 (data provider DP0), read from the local Data Bank mirror, as published. One display unit kept (ACTUALS). Amounts in ₹ crore; counts as numbers; ratios in per cent, as each row's label says. Bank groups are from the table's own bank-group column (Op Level4); its Bank Group Name column mislabels some banks. Numbers of accounts are left out: about a third are stored scaled by a thousand or more (up to 19 billion accounts for one bank) with no column saying which, so none can be trusted; the amounts are kept. Left out as printed in the wrong unit (Public sector banks, Bank of India, Total Agricultural Advances, Amount Outstanding on 2010-03-01; Public sector banks, Corporation bank, Total Agricultural Advances, Amount Outstanding on 2010-03-01).
